summary: A specification can freeze false assumptions, delay feedback and move hallucination from code into an authoritative-looking document.

points.text: Stakeholders often learn what they need from working software; a detailed pre-implementation spec can postpone the prototype that would expose the mistaken premise fastest.
An agent-generated specification may invent constraints, edge cases or acceptance criteria that the requester never chose, then validate code against its own fabricated authority.
Keeping specification, plan, tasks, tests and code synchronized creates substantial change overhead and several new drift surfaces.
Exploratory maintenance, incident response and small reversible fixes may be slowed by a full specification workflow with little compensating risk reduction.
